title: Rights and levels
lead: See what you may do in HiveVoice, why, and what you need for the next level.
leadShort: What you may do and why.

levels.name: Guest
levels.text: You can read. Sign in to take part.

levels.name: Account
levels.text: You can react, send contact requests, join groups and attach files. You may write in groups with open entry after the first day.

levels.name: Verified
levels.text: You may write everywhere, found groups, start initiatives, vote, register responsibilities and share.

levels.name: Official
levels.text: You speak for an office. Your role is confirmed by an official email.

levels.name: Moderation
levels.text: You look after running the platform, such as bans and settings. This is logged.

modes.login: In the test phase signing in counts as verified.
modes.vouch: You are verified when two verified people vouch for you and your account is a day old.
modes.eid: You are verified with the online ID.

vouchNone: Nobody vouches for you yet. Ask people who know you to vouch on your profile.
ageWait: Your account is {hours} hours old. After 24 hours the vouches count.
vouchGiven: In the last 30 days you gave {n} of 5 possible vouches.
sanctionOpen: Your account is paused ({kind}) until it is lifted.

actions.contact_request: Send a contact request to a stranger
actions.group_join: Join or ask to join groups

limitsHint: The daily limits protect everyone from spam. New accounts get half on their first day.
vouchHint: {name} is not verified yet. Only vouch for people you really know.

resource.view: View: depending on visibility everybody, the group, invited people or whoever knows the link.
resource.comment: Comment and suggest changes: people with the right to comment, with “suggestions” every verified reader.
resource.edit: Edit: the owner, invited people with the right to edit, with “the group edits” everybody with the group right for files.
resource.manage: Manage (rights, ownership, trash): whoever owns it, invited people with “manage” and the group's organisers.
resource.download: Download: when the switch is on. Whoever may edit can always download.
resource.copy: Copy into one's own Wissen: with a CC licence, or when downloading is allowed and “all rights reserved” does not apply.

initiative.support: Support: verified people, as long as the initiative is open and not blocked.
initiative.edit: Edit: the authors (and the organisers of the attached group when the group allows it), with a note.
initiative.invite_author: Invite a co-author: the authors, up to five including open invitations.
initiative.start_ballot: Start a vote: the authors, after the debate and with enough supporters for the place.
initiative.withdraw: Withdraw: the lead of the initiative.
initiative.delete: Delete: the lead, as long as only authors took part.

group.post: Write: members with the right to write.
group.invite: Invite: depending on the role and the invitation rule of the group.
group.manage_members: Manage members: the organisers and whoever was given the right.
group.delete: Delete: the owner, with 14 days of waiting.

responsibility.confirm: Confirm: verified people from the place of the responsibility.
responsibility.dispute: Dispute: verified people. Official bodies are excepted, there the check of the mail address counts.
responsibility.answer: Answer requests: whoever runs or represents the responsibility.
responsibility.edit: Edit and hand over: the main person responsible.

poll.manage: End or delete a poll: whoever created it, and the group's organisers and stewards.

message.edit: Change a message: only the sender, for 15 minutes.
message.delete: Delete a message: only the sender.

report.appeal: Appeal a decision: the person concerned, once and within the first 14 days.

why.not_authenticated: Sign in, then it may work.
why.level_required: You need level 2 (verified) for this. “Rights and levels” says what is missing.
why.not_shared: This is not shared with you. Ask the owner for access.
why.view_only: You may look at it but not change it. Ask for the right to edit.
why.suggest_only: You may suggest changes. The owner approves them.
why.not_owner: Only the owner may do this.
why.download_off: Downloading is switched off here. You can view it in the browser.
why.copy_not_allowed: This may not be copied (“all rights reserved”).
why.not_author: Only the authors may do this. You can join in with arguments and the discussion.
why.wrong_phase: This is not the right phase for it.
why.debate_too_short: The debate has to run a few days first.
why.not_enough_support: The vote still needs more supporters.
why.not_lead: Only the lead may do this. The lead can hand the lead over.
why.has_activity: Deleting is no longer possible because somebody has supported, voted or discussed.
why.too_many_authors: There are already as many authors and invitations as allowed.
why.not_member: Only members can do this. Join the group.
why.not_allowed: You have no right to this here. Ask the organisers.
why.not_admin: Only the organisers may do this.
why.not_affected: Only people from the place can do this.
why.official_role: Official responsibilities cannot be disputed this way.
why.duplicate: A dispute about this is running already.
why.not_holder: Only whoever runs the responsibility may do this.
why.not_creator: Whoever created it and the group's organisers may do this.
why.edit_window_over: The 15 minutes to change it are over.
why.unknown_action: There is no rule for this yet.

matrixLead: For everything one can do with a document, an initiative, a group or a responsibility there is exactly one rule. The interface and the database use the same one. Every row has tests.
